ITEM.PTXT: Normally, each computer detects the operating state of or a malfunction in its own system and sends an operation/warning light illumination request signal to the meter computer via CAN communication to illuminate the warning light of the relevant system.

If a communication malfunction is detected in the transmission path of the operation/warning light illumination request signal, the meter computer itself illuminates each operation/warning light according to the malfunction detection state.
